title: Orsen and the Witness
author: Dominic Galloway
blurb: Beatrix Iversen, a true-crime podcaster chasing the coldest case on record, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
